categories.main_business_segments: Power Construction Corporation of China (POWERCHINA) primarily operates in engineering contracting and surveying and design, power investment and operation, equipment manufacturing and leasing, and other related businesses. The company focuses on four main sectors: water resources and environment, energy and power, urban infrastructure, and digital engineering. It provides integrated services across the entire industry chain including planning, design, construction, operation, equipment manufacturing, and financing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies in hydropower, wind power, solar power, pumped storage, and nuclear power engineering. It emphasizes digital transformation with proprietary BIM software, intelligent construction platforms, and digital twin technologies. The firm also focuses on green and low-carbon technologies, including clean energy development, energy storage, and ecological restoration, supported by national key R&D projects and innovation platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: POWERCHINA serves primarily government entities, state-owned enterprises, and large infrastructure developers domestically and internationally. Its projects include major national strategic initiatives such as water network construction, renewable energy bases, urban infrastructure, and international Belt and Road projects. The company also caters to regional development zones and emerging markets in Asia, Africa, and Latin America.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, deeply involved in key regions like Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Economic Belt, Chengdu-Chongqing Economic Circle, and Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. Internationally, it has a significant presence in over 26 countries across Southeast Asia, Africa, Europe, and the Americas, with overseas projects and investments in countries such as Egypt, UAE, Serbia, Congo, Guinea, Brazil, and Pakistan.
categories.supply_chain_position: POWERCHINA operates primarily as an integrated midstream and downstream player in the infrastructure and energy supply chain. It undertakes engineering design, procurement, construction (EPC), investment, and operation of power and infrastructure projects, controlling the full lifecycle from planning to operation. It also engages in equipment manufacturing and leasing to support project execution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes strategic transformation towards high-quality development, focusing on clean energy, digitalization, and green infrastructure. It accelerates R&D in hydropower, wind-solar integration, energy storage, digital construction technologies, and industrial software. Innovation efforts include leading national key R&D projects, building innovation platforms, and fostering specialized 'little giant' enterprises to enhance core competitiveness and global leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through engineering contracting and design services, power investment and operation income, equipment manufacturing and leasing, and other related services. The company recognizes revenue based on contract progress for engineering projects and at point-in-time for power investment and other services. It also earns interest income and fees from financial services and project investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: POWERCHINA is positioned as a global leader in hydropower and power engineering, ranked first among global engineering design firms and power engineering contractors by ENR for multiple consecutive years. It holds dominant market shares in China’s hydropower, pumped storage, and renewable energy sectors, and is a top player in international infrastructure contracting. Competitors include other large Chinese state-owned construction and energy firms, but POWERCHINA maintains a leading edge through integrated capabilities and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 633.7 billion, a 4.07% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 12.02 billion. Total assets reached RMB 1.29 trillion, up 11.64%, with steady growth in contract backlog and international business. The company continues to expand its investment in strategic emerging industries, with over 40% revenue contribution from new energy and related sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: POWERCHINA offers comprehensive, integrated solutions across the entire infrastructure and energy project lifecycle, combining planning, design, construction, investment, and operation. Its unique value lies in its leadership in clean energy and water resource projects, advanced digital construction technologies, and strong international presence. The company emphasizes high-quality, green, intelligent, and innovative development to deliver sustainable infrastructure that supports national strategic goals and global connectivity.
